escalations.title: Handlebars.js Remote Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.exploit_scenario: If handlebars is used for dynamic template rendering with user-supplied input, AST type confusion allows arbitrary code execution in the Node.js process.
escalations.recommendation: Grep codebase for dynamic handlebars usage. If confirmed: upgrade to >=4.7.9 immediately or remove. If only in Babel transpile chain (build-time): lower risk, but update anyway.

escalations.title: Vite Host Header Confusion — CORS Bypass / MitM (CVSS 7.1)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Dev server accepts requests with forged Host header, allowing attacker-controlled assets, CORS bypass, and cache poisoning. If Vite ever runs in a production-adjacent environment, this is directly exploitable.
escalations.recommendation: Upgrade vite to >=5.4.3 in all Frontend modules. Add CI gate to fail if vite dev server is exposed on any port other than localhost.
escalations.trigger: sensitive data exposed — dev server leaks source/env vars

escalations.title: Portal/Backend: 54 CVEs in Observability Stack (2 Critical)
escalations.exploit_scenario: grpcx XSS via header injection and OpenTelemetry compression RCE create exploitable paths in the observability pipeline. Heavy @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node dependency tree creates massive attack surface.
escalations.recommendation: Audit actual telemetry features used. Replace auto-instrumentations-node with minimal SDK. Run npm audit fix. Escalate to TheGuardians for full triage of 2 critical CVEs.

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.exploit_scenario: POST multipart with field name containing \r\n injects arbitrary HTTP headers. If backend accepts multipart uploads from untrusted sources, CRLF enables response splitting.
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade form-data to >=4.0.6 via npm update in all modules. Verify no routes accept user-supplied multipart filenames.

p2_findings.title: esbuild Dev Server Localhost Escape (CVSS 5.3 — dev only)
p2_findings.exploit_scenario: Any website open in the developer's browser can send cross-origin requests to localhost:5173 and read dev server responses, including source maps and environment variable stubs.
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade vite to >=5.4.3 (includes patched esbuild). This fix is bundled with the DEP-002 remediation.
p2_findings.cross_ref: DEP-002 — same vite upgrade resolves both

p2_findings.title: React Router Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URL
p2_findings.exploit_scenario: A redirect to path //attacker.com is interpreted by React Router as same-origin but by the browser as protocol-relative, redirecting the user to attacker.com. Enables phishing and credential harvesting.

p2_findings.title: dev-workflow-platform.md Describes a Different Product — 74 FRs Unimplemented
p2_findings.exploit_scenario: Spec/reality mismatch causes new contributors to build against the wrong domain model. Requirements gate (traceability enforcer) passes while 74 declared requirements have zero coverage, masking the gap.
p2_findings.recommendation: Decision required: if spec is superseded, add [SUPERSEDED by workflow-engine.md] header and archive. If still in scope, create Plans/dev-workflow-platform/requirements.md mapping FR-001–FR-069 and schedule implementation.
p2_findings.cross_ref: QO-002 — enforcer blind spot hides this gap

p2_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Never Scans Specifications/ — 84 FRs Invisible to Gate
p2_findings.exploit_scenario: TRACEABILITY PASSED banner misleads reviewers. 84 of 97 declared FRs can be completely unimplemented and the gate will still pass, removing the main safety net for spec compliance.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer with --specs mode that scans Specifications/ for all FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ IDs and reports untraceable ones unless referenced in source. Minimum: add warning when Specifications/ FRs are absent from scanned plan.

p2_findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline.md FR-TMP-001–010 Have Zero Source Coverage
p2_findings.exploit_scenario: 10 requirements for risk classification, Playwright E2E generation, auto-PR creation, and auto-merge logic are declared but entirely unimplemented. If these are in-scope, the pipeline is missing critical automation.
p2_findings.recommendation: If in-scope: create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md and begin implementation. If deferred: add [STATUS: Deferred — Phase 2] to spec header.
p2_findings.cross_ref: QO-002 — enforcer blind spot hides this gap

p2_findings.title: Business Logic in Route Handlers — Architecture Rule Violated
p2_findings.exploit_scenario: Business logic in route handlers cannot be independently tested or reused. State machine bypass risk: a future route that duplicates approve/reject logic without calling the service may skip validation.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract approve/reject state-transition logic into services/workflowActions.ts. Route handlers call service and return result — no store imports, no changeHistory mutation inline.

p2_findings.title: GET /api/search Not Implemented — search.test.ts Intentionally Fails
p2_findings.exploit_scenario: FR-dependency-search is declared but not wired. Test file documents the contract but is permanently failing until implemented. Users attempting to search get 404 with no explanation.
p2_findings.recommendation: Implement Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts with GET /api/search?q=<query> returning {data: WorkItem[]}, wire in app.ts, add // Verifies: FR-dependency-search comment.
